title: 「X is easier said than done」
titleEn: Using “X is easier said than done”

formula: X + be + easier said than done

formulas.formula: X + be + easier said than done

example: Changing an old habit is easier said than done.
exampleZh: 改掉舊習慣說來容易，做起來卻很難。

examples.en: Changing an old habit is easier said than done.
examples.zh: 改掉舊習慣說來容易，做起來卻很難。
examples.highlight: Changing an old habit is easier said than done.

rules.zh: 和 done 是固定形式正確：【easier said than done】 錯誤：【easier say than do；easier saying than doing；easier said than do】 詞語【said】和 done 在這個固定表達中不能隨意改變。
rules.en: said easier said than done easier say than do easier saying than doing easier said than do

rules.zh: 固定比較結構 easier said than done 中的 than 不可省略；省去 than 會令兩個過去分詞失去正確的比較關係。
rules.en: than The plan is easier said than done. The plan is easier said done.

rules.zh: 按主語、時態或語氣改寫時，只改變前面的 be 動詞；easier said than done 這個比較部分保持不變。
rules.en: The plan is easier said than done. The plan was easier said than done. The plan has been easier said than done. The plan may be easier said than done.

rules.zh: 必須是可以實行、完成或達成的事情自然：【Changing a habit is easier said than done.】 自然：【Keeping the promise is easier said than done.】 不自然：【The blue chair is easier said than done.】 椅子本身不是一項需要實行或完成的行動，因此不適合使用這個表達。
rules.en: X Changing a habit is easier said than done. Keeping the promise is easier said than done. The blue chair is easier said than done.

rules.zh: 這個表達不是字面比較說話和做事並不是指說出 “changing a company’s culture” 這幾個字很容易。它表示：提出「改變公司文化」這個想法很容易，但真正令改變發生卻很困難。
rules.en: Changing a company’s culture is easier said than done.

rules.zh: 本課不以其他近義改寫作為答案以下句子意思相近，但不是本課的目標答案：【It is easy to talk about but difficult to achieve.】 本練習要求使用固定表達：【easier said than done】
rules.en: It is easy to talk about but difficult to achieve. It sounds simple but is difficult in practice. The idea is easier to describe than to carry out. easier said than done

benefits.zh: 這個表達能指出「想法」與「現實」之間的差距。某項建議可能聽起來很簡單，但實際執行卻很困難。
benefits.en: It shows the difference between an idea and reality This expression tells the listener that a suggestion may sound simple, although carrying it out is difficult.

benefits.zh: 你不需要作出一段很長的解釋，只需使用一個常見的固定表達。第二句較短、更直接，而且仍然保留主要意思。
benefits.en: It expresses a long idea in a short form Instead of giving a long explanation, you can use one familiar expression. Compare: People often say that changing a company’s culture is simple, but actually changing the behaviour and attitudes of the employees is extremely difficult. Changing a company’s culture is easier said than done.

benefits.zh: 你可以用它指出某項建議不容易實行，而不需要直接批評對方錯誤，因此語氣可以比較自然和婉轉。例句 A：只要叫所有人工作快一點便可以。例句 B：這說來容易，做起來卻很難。
benefits.en: It helps you disagree without sounding too aggressive You can use it to question an unrealistic suggestion without directly saying that the other person is wrong. A: Just ask everyone to work faster. B: That is easier said than done.

benefits.zh: 這個表達能提醒讀者考慮實際困難，令討論、作文和報告不會只停留在理想層面。
benefits.en: It adds realism to discussions and arguments The expression reminds readers that practical difficulties must be considered.

benefits.zh: 這個表達可以作為句子的主要訊息，也可以放在 that 從句、although 從句或關係子句中，讓你的句式更有變化。
benefits.en: It can appear in many parts of a sentence You can use it as the main message, inside a that-clause, after although, or inside a relative clause.

benefits.zh: 它適合用於日常對話，也適合討論習慣、計劃、承諾、政策、商業改革和社會問題。
benefits.en: It is useful in everyday and professional English It can be used when discussing habits, plans, promises, policies, business changes and social problems.

questions.prompt: People say that one solution can satisfy everyone, but finding such a solution is difficult in practice.

questions.highlight: Although bringing lasting change to an organisation is much easier said than done, clear leadership and honest communication can make it possible.
